1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising an active ingredient, wherein the active ingredient is a compound of formula I:

__[Chemical structure showing indole derivative with R1, R2, R3, R4, R5 substituents as defined in the specification]__

__wherein R1, R2, R3, R4, and R5 are as defined in the specification,__

__and wherein the compound of formula I is specifically selected from the group consisting of compounds disclosed in the specification but excluding 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic acid and salts thereof.__

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently Amended) Composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care __and/or__ inflammation-inhibiting action, __wherein the composition is formulated for treatment of existing skin conditions__.

4. (Currently Amended) Composition according to __Claim 1 or 3__, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0,00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Previously presented)

6. (Currently Amended) Composition according to claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine __in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight__.

7. (Currently Amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition __for treatment of existing skin conditions__.

8. (Currently Amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the __treatment__ of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, __specifically__ for the treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect, such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis, for the treatment of other defects of keratinisation, __specifically__ ichthyosis, ichthyosiform states, Darier's disease, keratosis palmo-plantaris, leukoplakia, leukoplakiform states, skin and mucosal (buccal) eczema (lichen), for the treatment of other skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation and have an inflammatory and/or immunoallergic component, and __specifically__ all forms of psoriasis relating to the skin, mucous membranes and finger- and toenails, and psoriatic rheumatism and skin atopy, such as eczema, or respiratory atopy, or also hypertrophy of the gums.

9. (Currently Amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair __treatment__ and/or hair follicle __treatment__.

10. (Currently Amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment for improvement of__ the general state of the skin or hair.

11. (Previously presented)

12. (Currently Amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 __or 3__ for skin lightening and/or skin whitening __treatment__.

13. (Currently Amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment of__ skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin.

14. (Currently Amended) Use __of__ the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the __treatment of__ time- and/or light-induced ageing processes of the human skin or human hair, __specifically__ for __treatment of__ dry skin, wrinkle formation and/or pigment defects, and/or for the reduction __of__ the harmful effects of UV rays on the skin.
